repo_notes.content: Rails 8.1 app (Ruby 3.4) with two medical calculators: drug steady-state concentration over time, and blood-pressure graphs from uploaded CSV. Both render Gruff line graphs returned as PNG via send_data.
No database at all: the active_record railtie is not loaded and there is no config/database.yml — all computation is request-scoped.
Key gotcha: the json gem is pinned ~> 2.0 — json 3.0 changed JSON.parse arity and breaks ActiveSupport session cookie decryption. Do not upgrade without verifying.
Key gotcha: gruff depends on rmagick — do not swap rmagick for ruby-vips without also replacing gruff.
Bulma 1.0.2 is committed locally (not CDN); Propshaft serves application.css before bulma.min.css alphabetically, so overrides need !important.
See AGENTS.md for full conventions, constraints, and verification commands.
